name: does-gpt-cheat
description: Transparent, user-controlled detection of silent model downgrades in Codex sessions: a zero-token passive scan of the session rollout on every turn, plus ModelTrace fingerprint probes run in ephemeral forks of the thread (the mechanism behind /side) on a schedule you choose. Verdicts are delivered by a snarky Codex pet.

hooks.description: does-gpt-cheat: passive session-integrity scan, probe scheduling, verdict delivery, optional halt

hooks.statusMessage: does-gpt-cheat: scanning session for silent downgrades

interface.shortDescription: Catch silent model downgrades in your Codex sessions
interface.longDescription: does-gpt-cheat watches every Codex thread for silent model, reasoning-effort and context-window changes (zero tokens), and on a schedule you choose forks the thread ephemerally to run ModelTrace fingerprint probes that attribute the answering model. Results arrive as a Codex-pet card, a macOS notification and a message in the thread. Everything stays on your machine. Fingerprint bank and scorer: github.com/xqy2006/ModelTrace (MIT).
defaultPrompt: Did Codex silently downgrade this session? Use $does-gpt-cheat.
